blocks.text: The same question can get a weak or a brilliant answer – it all depends on how you ask. This is called writing a prompt.
Important: Claude is for adults (18+). So practise the Claude lessons together with a parent, who uses their own account.
Important: you may use ChatGPT from age 13 and only with a parent's permission. If you're younger, practise together with a parent.
Important: you need a parent's permission for Gemini. Younger children can use it only through a parent's Family Link account, where available.

items: What you want: explain, write, list, compare.
Who you are: your age and what you already know.
What kind of answer: short, in points, with an example.

blocks.text: Brilliant: "I'm 11. Explain why the dinosaurs died out, in 5 short points, with one fun fact at the end."
If you don't like the answer, don't give up – say what to change: "shorter", "simpler", "add an example".
I'm 12. Compare cats and dogs in a table: food, care, play, how long they live.
